fusions.name: Second Glance
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Lashes a chain around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Reeling In
fusions.desc: Pulls you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away.

fusions.name: Carried Over
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, a bolt leaps to the nearest other enemy within 5 tiles for 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.
